dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Hmm... Seems fine on the surface. The machinery runs smoothly, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you fixing something?

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: ...Yeah, just some trivial stuff. Also, my client's asked me to make them some small components.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: I used to do a lot of work at the Rossum Workshop, but these days, many clients just approach me directly.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Looks like I've made something of a name for myself around here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something bothering you?

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Well, it's not a bother per se, but... I'm just a bit puzzled.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Lately, Aino's been telling me to "consider the connections between structures"... I tried thinking like her, but the harder I focus, the more tangled everything gets.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Maybe I just don't have this flexible "space" in my brain like she does, where she can just mentally put everything together.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: She says it's easy... But it's actually a tall order for most.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I won't bother you then!

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Hmm... Alright then...

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Hmm... The small mechanisms have started to work, but... how can I switch components more flexibly...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you fixing something?

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's some work that Aino gave me. I had a few clients before who asked me to make and repair a series of mechanical components.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: It didn't look complicated, so I stepped in to help — but I didn't realize that those parts could be assembled into a controller for the cannon and its force fields...

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Aino gave me a real earful for that... *sigh* If only I'd realized something was off when I was working on them...

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll have to be more careful in the future. Since the work I'm currently doing was assigned by Aino herself, there shouldn't be any issues..
